item.title: Introducing DoorDash Tasks
item.description:

item.title: A case against currying
item.description:
📝 I want to argue that when you define functions in this style, although it is nice and elegant, there are also some things that are lost. There are roughly three different "styles" that programming languages offer for writing multi-parameter function definitions with. We can totally do partial application for functions in the parameter list style or tuple style.
🔗 Read more: https://emi-h.com/articles/a-case-against-currying.html
